svg.title: OligoArk animated DNA-like storage workflow
svg.desc: A 20-second looping conceptual animation showing an original file, DNA-like strand encoding, simulated errors, and SHA-256-verified recovery on a successful example. Not physical DNA synthesis.
svg.text: How a DNA-like digital archive can be tested in software

g.text: Illustrative successful simulation — SHA-256 verifies exact file recovery

svg.text: Software Simulation — No Physical DNA Synthesis
Recovery depends on conditions; not every simulated error scenario succeeds.
